tables.name: staging.stg_ar_transactions
tables.grain: One row per AR transaction snapshot

columns.name: ar_source_key
columns.description: Source system surrogate key for the AR transaction

columns.name: claim_id
columns.description: Claim identifier from the billing system

columns.name: days_outstanding
columns.description: Days the balance has been outstanding

columns.name: patient_financial_class
columns.description: Patient Financial Classification (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, Self Pay, Workers Comp)

columns.name: primary_payer_id
columns.description: Primary payer natural key for the patient

columns.name: payer_type
columns.description: Payer category such as Commercial or Government

columns.name: provider_specialty
columns.description: Primary specialty of the rendering provider

tables.name: rcm.fact_ar
tables.grain: One row per claim AR balance snapshot

columns.name: ar_key
columns.description: Surrogate key for the AR fact row

columns.name: aging_bucket
columns.description: AR aging bucket derived from days outstanding

tables.name: rcm.fact_denial
tables.grain: One row per denied claim line

columns.name: denial_key
columns.description: Surrogate key for the denial fact row

views.name: rcm.vw_ar_detail
views.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW rcm.vw_ar_detail AS
SELECT
    f.claim_id,
    p.patient_id,
    p.patient_name,
    pay.payer_name,
    f.charge_amount,
    f.payment_amount,
    f.adjustment_amount,
    f.denial_amount,
    f.balance,
    f.aging_bucket
FROM rcm.fact_ar f
JOIN rcm.dim_patient p ON p.patient_key = f.patient_key
JOIN rcm.dim_payer pay ON pay.payer_key = f.payer_key;

views.name: rcm.vw_ar_aging_summary
views.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW rcm.vw_ar_aging_summary AS
SELECT
    f.aging_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS claim_count,
    SUM(f.balance) AS total_balance
FROM rcm.fact_ar f
GROUP BY f.aging_bucket;

views.name: rcm.vw_denial_detail
views.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW rcm.vw_denial_detail AS
SELECT
    d.claim_id,
    pay.payer_name,
    d.denial_code,
    d.denial_amount
FROM rcm.fact_denial d
JOIN rcm.dim_payer pay ON pay.payer_key = d.payer_key;

routines.name: rcm.sp_load_ar_fact
routines.body:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE rcm.sp_load_ar_fact()
AS $$
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM rcm.fact_ar;

    INSERT INTO rcm.fact_ar (
        ar_key,
        claim_id,
        patient_key,
        payer_key,
        charge_amount,
        payment_amount,
        adjustment_amount,
        denial_amount,
        balance,
        aging_bucket,
        load_date
    )
    SELECT
        s.ar_source_key,
        s.claim_id,
        p.patient_key,
        pay.payer_key,
        s.charge_amount,
        s.payment_amount,
        s.adjustment_amount,
        s.denial_amount,
        s.charge_amount - s.payment_amount - s.adjustment_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN s.days_outstanding <= 30 THEN '0-30'
            WHEN s.days_outstanding <= 60 THEN '31-60'
            WHEN s.days_outstanding <= 90 THEN '61-90'
            ELSE '90+'
        END,
        s.service_date
    FROM staging.stg_ar_transactions s
    JOIN rcm.dim_patient p ON p.patient_id = s.patient_id
    JOIN rcm.dim_payer pay ON pay.payer_id = s.payer_id;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

routines.name: rcm.sp_load_denial_fact
routines.body:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE rcm.sp_load_denial_fact()
AS $$
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM rcm.fact_denial;

    INSERT INTO rcm.fact_denial (
        denial_key,
        claim_id,
        payer_key,
        denial_code,
        denial_amount
    )
    SELECT
        s.ar_source_key,
        s.claim_id,
        pay.payer_key,
        'CO-45',
        s.denial_amount
    FROM staging.stg_ar_transactions s
    JOIN rcm.dim_payer pay ON pay.payer_id = s.payer_id
    WHERE s.denial_amount > 0;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
